key.name: toggle-vitresearch
key.description: Accelerator that toggles the Vitre Search bar. It is registered only when no other GNOME keybinding uses it (GNOME uses Super+Space for switching input sources); otherwise the extension logs one line and leaves it unregistered. Set another accelerator, or move input switching, to activate it.

key.name: use-remote-providers
key.description: Include the same search providers as the overview (Files, Calculator, Settings, ...), honouring the Settings search switches. Applications and system actions are always included.

key.name: filters-on-pointer
key.summary: Show the filter buttons when the pointer moves over the bar
key.description: The four filter buttons (Apps, Files, Actions, Clipboard) split out of the bar when Tab is pressed; when this is on, moving the pointer over an empty bar does the same.
